name: Infieles
description: Erotic comedy series about infidelity in couples and the different situations that lead people to commit it. The episodes use as reasons, among others, serious sexual disagreement, simple use of a favorable moment without thinking about the consequences, habits or deteriorating or unpleasant attitudes, etc. Without ever losing humor and mischief.

videos.title: The Craving
videos.overview: Between his pregnant wife and a sexy matron, Renato has his hands full on the eve of his child's birth. Will he give into temptation with the matron, or stay by his loving wife in the middle of a life-changing event?

videos.title: A Very Personal Tutor
videos.overview: Worried about her son's academic failures, Rebeca hires Santiago, a book-smart student to be her son's tutor. Soon, Rebeca finds that Santiago has a few thing to teach in her bedroom also.

videos.title: The King of Love
videos.overview: Blue-collar worker Yorgo finds himself tangled with his neighbor, Alicia, a woman who sends his mind spinning.

videos.title: Talent Scout
videos.overview: It's love in the fast lane in this tale of romance between a handsome star athlete and the woman who has won his heart.

videos.title: Executive Vengeance
videos.overview: All that Mariana's sleazy coworkers focus on is her beautiful looks. After one too many creepy passes from her boss, Mariana decides to take a stand against these workplace slobs and show the world what she's made of.

videos.title: Lady Soccer
videos.overview: Love is a game, and everybody wants to score. Susan joins a soccer team to fix her relationship with husband Max. But she soon finds herself tempted by the squad's handsome coach, Chalo.

videos.title: Catfight
videos.overview: A nightclub catfight gone wrong between two jealous girlfriends takes a deadlier turn after one woman becomes a dancer at the same club.

videos.title: Wet Wonder
videos.overview: Handsome swimming instructor Fulvio has a womanizing problem. When one woman spills the beans on Fulvio's affairs to his wife, the hunk plots revenge.

videos.title: Sexy Swinger
videos.overview: Charly's neighbors have wild parties all day and night. Married and frustrated, he decides to take action. But things take a sizzling turn when he crosses paths with the attractive, alluring woman living next door.

videos.title: The Naughty Impersonator
videos.overview: Two playboys, both vying for the affections of a woman, find themselves in a tangled game of one-upmanship.

videos.title: Guardian Angels
videos.overview: In this romantic comedy, the hospital is the site of romance and madness. When Angel is admitted for a bad sickness, he meets his old lover, Angela, who is on the verge of marrying another man. When the former lovers meet again, they find the old flame may still be burning.

videos.title: Spider Woman
videos.overview: Strong-willed Miriam and her ex-lover, the mariachi Miguel, find their long-ago passions heating up once more in this romantic comedy. Years after an accident changed Miguel and ruined their romance, the old duo find new sparks.

videos.title: Halloween
videos.overview: Halloween eve promises wild antics for best friends Henry and Theobald, who find themselves on an adventure of sexy costumes and raunchy tomfoolery.

videos.title: San Juan Nights
videos.overview: Ladies' man Professor Lalo has his playboy lifestyle upended. Seeking to tame his wild ways, Lalo crosses paths with Norma, a woman who may change his life forever.

videos.title: A Thousand Ways to Have Fun
videos.overview: Aureliano finds himself "living the dream" when a former flame moves in with he and his devoted wife. But soon enough, Aureliano finds his dream going sour.

videos.title: Boy Toy
videos.overview: Passion sizzles between a charming con artist and a jail guard.

videos.title: Blind Eyes
videos.overview: A funeral leads to romantic desires and tangled affairs when Richi's father-in-law passes away, he finds himself squaring off with Claudia, the late man's daughter, in a dance of deception and love.

videos.title: Carnal Vice
videos.overview: The adventures of a cop who can't resist the women in his neighborhood.

videos.title: Surprise, Surprise
videos.overview: On her wedding day, a bride to be's old lover stirs deep sensual passions. Soon enough, they're beginning an affair, and the bells haven't even rung yet!

videos.title: Tequila
videos.overview: Veronica wakes up from a wild night at the bar with a mysterious tattoo on her leg. With the help of her friends, Veronica looks to piece together the events of the night before.

videos.title: The Soto Sisters
videos.overview: Yola and Gina are two sisters whose marriages have gone stale. When they go on a road trip to reunite with two old buddies, the sisters find romance rekindled by the handsome suitors from long ago.

videos.title: Love Thy Neighbor
videos.overview: Chalo's personal struggles are putting his marriage on ice. When the kind, intelligent, alluring Maria Jesus moves next door, Chalo searches for a healing to his problems at home.

videos.title: Neighbors
videos.overview: Neighborly tensions are on a whole new level when handsome soccer star Pablo and his beautiful wife Fernanda move next door to the unemployed Lulo, sparks fly between Lulo and Fernanda.

videos.title: Furious Attraction
videos.overview: Dani and Juli are a couple running a funeral business together. Little does his wife know that Dani carries on affairs with mourning widows. When he falls for Fatima, a woman whose deceased husband was an underworld power, Dani finds his secret world turned upside down.

videos.title: A Family Affair
videos.overview: Tensions rise when Sandra and her sailor boyfriend move in with Sandra's mother-in-law.
